title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock V
summary: Given an array of stock prices and an integer k, determine the maximum profit by performing at most k transactions, where each transaction can be a normal buy-sell or a short sell-buy cycle, with the constraint that each transaction must be completed before starting another and no simultaneous buying and selling.
statement: Given an array of stock prices and an integer k, determine the maximum profit by performing at most k transactions, where each transaction can be a normal buy-sell or a short sell-buy cycle, with the constraint that each transaction must be completed before starting another and no simultaneous buying and selling.
constraints: prices has 2 to 1,000 days and 1 <= k <= len(prices)//2.
A transaction is either buy-then-sell or short-sell-then-buy-back on later days.
Transactions cannot overlap or close and reopen on the same day.
hints: For each transaction allowance, the end-of-day state is closed, holding a long position, or holding a short position.
Update every state from the previous day only, preventing a close and a new open on the same day.
Closed may stay or close long/short; open states may stay or open from closed with one fewer allowed transaction.
The three states cover every legal position, and previous-day transitions enforce ordering and non-overlap while maximizing profit for each prefix.
editorial: The three states cover every legal position, and previous-day transitions enforce ordering and non-overlap while maximizing profit for each prefix.

tests.explanation: Buy at one and sell at nine for eight, then short at eight and cover at two for six, totaling 14.
A long profit seven, short profit eleven, and long profit eighteen total 36.
